# GET /api/v1/users/{username}/tokens

List the authenticated user's access tokens (requires basic auth or reverse proxy auth)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** basic_or_reverse_proxy · **ID:** `ep-164`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — AccessTokenList

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Token ID |
| `name` | string | Token name |
| `sha1` | string | Always empty in list (token not stored) |
| `token_last_eight` | string | Last 8 chars of token |
| `scopes` | []string | Token scopes |
| `created_at` | time | Creation timestamp |
| `last_used_at` | time | Last usage timestamp |

- **403** — Not self or admin
